title: Anthropic Admin API key (sk-ant-admin01-): one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: one identifier character before the prefix, so the key is embedded in a longer token and boundary: underscores in place of the provider-documented hyphens (sk_ant_admin01_). Twin of "Anthropic Admin API key (sk-ant-admin01-): must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of anthropic-admin01-key-curl-x-api-key: boundary: underscores in place of the provider-documented hyphens (sk_ant_admin01_). Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
